name: Umbra
description: Mobile hero who can cloak and jump to ambush enemies. Can temporarily transform into an Twisted Visage, which deals devastating melee damage.

abilities.name: Jump
abilities.description:
Jump to a location and deal {x} damage in area
Targets are slowed by {slow}% for {slowduration} seconds

abilities.name: Transform
abilities.description:
Transform into Twisted Visage form for {x} seconds
Instantly heals {healpercent}% of max health, and refreshes Jump cooldown upon transforming

abilities.name: Cloak
abilities.description: Targeted unit gains cloak and +{speed}% movement speed for {duration} seconds.
